summary.text: Jane Timken is a Republican state senator from Ohio who has represented District 29 since January 2025 and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
She is a former chair of the Republican Party of Ohio.

paragraphs.text: Jane Timken earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University and a law degree from American University.
Her career experience includes serving as a Republican national committeewoman.
Timken was vice chairwoman of the Republican Party of Ohio from 2010 and was elected its chair in January 2017.
Ohio Senate Republicans appointed her on January 29, 2025, to replace Kirk Schuring in District 29.
She advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Thomas West in the general election.
